newsHighlights.title: Francis Halzen wins 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics
newsHighlights.summary: Belgian scientist Francis Halzen has been awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics for decisive contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and the discovery of high-energy neutrinos.
newsHighlights.translation: 比利时科学家弗朗西斯·哈尔岑因对冰立方中微子天文台的决定性贡献以及高能中微子的发现，荣获2026年诺贝尔物理学奖。

newsHighlights.title: Coffee majors rewriting playbook in China
newsHighlights.summary: For years, success in China's coffee market was measured by two numbers: how many stores a company could open and how cheaply it could sell a cup of joe — a formula now being rewritten.
newsHighlights.translation: 多年来，中国咖啡市场的成功一直用两个数字衡量：能开多少家店、一杯咖啡能卖多便宜——如今这一套打法正被改写。

newsHighlights.title: Logistics base boosts Sino-Central Asian connectivity
newsHighlights.summary: A major logistics base is strengthening connectivity between China and Central Asia, powered by smart tracking and digital supply-chain technology.
newsHighlights.translation: 一座大型物流基地借助智能追踪与数字化供应链技术，正在增强中国与中亚之间的互联互通。

newsHighlights.title: Ceramic paradise in Jingdezhen
newsHighlights.summary: International artists gather in Jingdezhen's Sanbao Ceramic Art Village, where ancient craft meets modern digital design and 3D printing technology.
newsHighlights.translation: 国际艺术家汇聚景德镇三宝国际陶瓷艺术村，古老工艺与现代数字设计、3D打印技术在此交融。

quote.quote: Somewhere, something incredible is waiting to be known.
quote.author: Carl Sagan
quote.translation: 在某个地方，某种不可思议的事物正等待着被我们认识。
quote.explanation: 这句名言出自美国天文学家卡尔·萨根，鼓励人们保持对未知的好奇与探索精神——正如冰立方中微子天文台从南极冰层深处捕捉到幽灵般的中微子，把'不可知'变成'已知'。

vocabulary.definition: 中微子（一种几乎无质量、极少与其他物质相互作用的基本粒子）
vocabulary.example: The IceCube Neutrino Observatory detected high-energy neutrino events deep beneath the Antarctic ice.
vocabulary.translation: 冰立方中微子天文台在南极冰层深处探测到了高能中微子事件。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自诺奖新闻：'the discovery of high-energy neutrinos'（高能中微子的发现）。

vocabulary.example: The observatory uses thousands of sensors to watch for faint flashes of light in the ice.
vocabulary.translation: 这座天文台使用数千个传感器，观测冰层中微弱的闪光。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自诺奖新闻：'decisive contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory'。

vocabulary.example: Halzen made decisive contributions to the design and construction of the observatory.
vocabulary.translation: 哈尔岑对该天文台的设计与建造做出了决定性的贡献。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自诺奖新闻：'for decisive contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory'。

vocabulary.example: Scientific breakthroughs often rest on the contributions of many researchers over decades.
vocabulary.translation: 科学突破往往建立在数十年间众多研究者的贡献之上。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自诺奖新闻：'decisive contributions to...'（对……的决定性贡献）。

vocabulary.example: The discovery of high-energy neutrinos opened a new window onto the universe.
vocabulary.translation: 高能中微子的发现为观测宇宙打开了一扇新的窗口。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自诺奖新闻：'the discovery of high-energy neutrinos'。

vocabulary.example: That formula helped transform China's coffee market within a single decade.
vocabulary.translation: 那一套打法在短短十年间改变了中国的咖啡市场。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自咖啡新闻：'That formula helped transform...'（这一公式帮助改变了……）。

vocabulary.definition: 公式；（成功的）固定方法、套路
vocabulary.example: Opening more stores and selling cheaper coffee was once the winning formula in China.
vocabulary.translation: 多开店、卖便宜咖啡曾是中国市场的制胜法则。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自咖啡新闻：'That formula helped transform China's coffee market'。

vocabulary.example: The new logistics base shortens delivery times between China and Central Asia.
vocabulary.translation: 这座新的物流基地缩短了中国与中亚之间的运输时间。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自物流新闻：'Logistics base boosts Sino-Central Asian connectivity'。

vocabulary.example: Digital technology is boosting connectivity across the entire region.
vocabulary.translation: 数字技术正在提升整个区域的互联互通水平。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自物流新闻标题：'boosts Sino-Central Asian connectivity'。

vocabulary.example: Jingdezhen has been a ceramic paradise for over a thousand years.
vocabulary.translation: 一千多年来，景德镇一直是陶瓷的天堂。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自陶瓷新闻标题：'Ceramic paradise in Jingdezhen'。

pattern.pattern: be awarded + 奖项 + for + 名词/动名词（因……被授予……）
pattern.example: Francis Halzen has been awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics 2026 for decisive contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory.
pattern.translation: 弗朗西斯·哈尔岑因对冰立方中微子天文台的决定性贡献，被授予2026年诺贝尔物理学奖。
pattern.usage: 该句型用于表达'因某成就/贡献而获得某奖项或荣誉'。for 后接名词短语或动名词，说明获奖原因。也可替换为 be awarded sth. for doing sth.，例如：She was awarded a medal for saving the children.

grammar.title: 现在完成时的被动语态（Present Perfect Passive）
grammar.explanation: 结构为 have/has + been + 过去分词，表示'到目前为止已经被……'，强调过去发生的动作对现在造成的结果或影响，常用于新闻报道中描述刚刚发生的重大事件。第三人称单数用 has been + done。
examples: Belgian scientist Francis Halzen has been awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics 2026 for decisive contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory.
High-energy neutrinos have been discovered and studied by scientists using detectors buried deep in the Antarctic ice.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第二个音节 zɜːr 上，首音节弱读为 /əb/，不是 /ɒb/。注意 /z/ 是浊辅音而非 /s/，结尾的 /tɔːri/ 要清晰但不要拖长。可拆成 ob-ZUR-vuh-tor-ee 慢速练习，再连读。
examples: The IceCube Neutrino Observatory lies beneath the South Pole.
Scientists at the observatory have been watching the sky for more than a decade.

reading.title: Listening to the Universe: The Science Behind the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics
reading.content:
Belgian scientist Francis Halzen has been awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics for decisive contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory. Located deep beneath the Antarctic ice, IceCube is not a traditional telescope. Instead, it uses thousands of digital sensors to detect faint flashes of light produced when neutrinos — tiny, ghost-like particles — collide with ice.

Neutrinos rarely interact with matter, so detecting them demands both enormous scale and advanced technology. Machine learning and AI algorithms now help scientists separate real signals from background noise, turning mountains of raw data into scientific discovery.

The observatory's success shows how artificial intelligence has become an essential partner of modern science. From mapping the stars to rewriting the playbook of global business, technology continues to transform every field it touches. As Carl Sagan once wrote, somewhere, something incredible is waiting to be known.
reading.translation:
比利时科学家弗朗西斯·哈尔岑因对冰立方中微子天文台的决定性贡献，荣获2026年诺贝尔物理学奖。冰立方位于南极冰层之下，并非传统望远镜。它使用数千个数字传感器，探测中微子——这种幽灵般的微小粒子——与冰碰撞时产生的微弱闪光。

中微子极少与物质发生相互作用，因此探测它们既需要庞大的规模，也需要先进技术。如今，机器学习与人工智能算法帮助科学家把真实信号从背景噪声中分离出来，将海量原始数据转化为科学发现。

这座天文台的成功表明，人工智能已成为现代科学不可或缺的伙伴。从描绘星辰到改写全球商业的打法，科技持续改变着它所触及的每一个领域。正如卡尔·萨根所写：在某个地方，某种不可思议的事物正等待着被我们认识。
reading.sourceNote: 基于 ChinaDaily / CGTN 2026年10月7日报道《Francis Halzen wins 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics》改写，并结合当日咖啡市场与科技相关素材进行主题延伸。
